entities.name: Grand Junction Gift Shop
entities.source_summary: Playland souvenir shop with a defined 20-100eb gift range and a daily scooter-rental service.
entities.catalogue_note: The source gives a specific souvenir assortment. Substituting broad entertainment, fashion, electronics or general-equipment catalogue items would make the shop less accurate, so no generated catalogue shelf is used.

audit.note: The audit's 100eb cap is retained as a source-defined gift range rather than being applied to unrelated generated merchandise.
